questions.Description:
Calculate the cost of following print job:
Book = 1000 copies, No. of Pages = 96 pages, size = 8 ½ x 11 1/4 “, Inside pages printing = Front + Back - 1 color – Black, Paper = 80 gsm maplitho paper, Wrapper = Front Cover + Back Cover – 4 Color Printing, Board = 220 gsm Art card, Cover - Matt Lamination, Binding – Adhesive / Perfect Binding.
Analyze and optimize a print production workflow for offset printing process.
Conduct a time and motion study for a flexographic printing process.
Develop and implement a resource allocation plan for a book production - print job.
Perform quality control tests on multicolour printed samples.
Track and manage inventory levels of printing materials – Paper, Board, Printing Inks.
Create a production schedule for packaging product/jobs.
Design and evaluate a workstation layout for label printing works for improved efficiency.
Conduct a cost-benefit analysis for offset – flexography – gravure printing technologies.
Map out and analyze a offset printing process from start to finish.
